point_one_B.asr_text: .1 families found the Knight Rule easiest to use. In one test, 309 families joint. It tested three ways to cut screen time. Families said the Knight Rule was easiest to use. Again and again, families said this rule helped them sleep better.Still, some teenagers moved their screen time instead.They used screens just before the rule began or after it ended, so the rule did not make the screen time problem go away.
